review_text: Ang ganda ng place nato. Masarap din ang food. We ordered coffee, revel bars & pasta. Worth it! Not to mention the nice scenery of nature at the back portion of the cafè. Very relaxing

The place is a short drive away from downtown area. It's just beside the road but the traffic noise is not audible inside the cafe. It has somewhat rustic, industrial, and wooden vibes that I absolutely love. The food and service are great, the serving is huge, and the view of the trees outside is so relaxing. We were also amazed at the artworks and woodcrafts being displayed at the Gil Bumanlag Gallery which offers free entrance to the cafe customers. Overall, it was a great dining experience and worth every penny we spent!
Best matcha shop for me and the vibes was so vibing. Approachable staffs and clean
This is an amazing establishment that truly must be seen to be believed. The ambiance is otherworldly, the food is spectacular, and the service is absolutely top-notch.

We went here on January 1, and luckily, they were open. The overall aesthetic of the place was impressive, as expected from a design by an artist. What I liked most was the beautiful nature view. I also appreciated the freedom to roam around their gallery. The food was just okay, but I hope they improve on the small details. We ordered pasta but were only given a fork, and the water was served in a single-use plastic cup, which didn't really match the vibe of the place. I'd like to try their rice dishes next time I visit.

Wood and Coffee Davao is a fantastic find! It's the perfect nature escape for coffee lovers. The food is delicious, and their matcha is seriously amazing. It's also a great study spot – quiet, with plenty of outlets – but be aware that cell service is non-existent (though they have Wi-Fi, which can be slow when busy). There's a 5% service charge. Finally, having your own transport is a must, especially in the rain, as tricycles are scarce.

The food is good. When serving, they ask for table numbers, but some tables either don't have them or the numbers are unclear. This forces customers to look for another table with a visible number. In our case, we ended up without a proper table number and had to give the staff the number of a nearby table instead 🥲

We chose to spend our post-Valentine's date and monthly "out of the office" outing here with our team. Though the traffic made it a bit far, the trip was worth it! The place is beautiful, the food is great, and they even have a free-entry gallery museum showcasing stunning artwork.

Where verdant hues and earthy scents combine, A tranquil haven, where soft moments twine. Green whispers rise, from powdered leaves so fine, And nature's touch, creates a sweet design. With crafted wood, and steaming, emerald grace, A peaceful respite, in a calm, warm space.

Lovely ambiance. Industrial meets nature. Very woody, undone feels yet looks good! Love the outdoor sitting. You just need a mosquito repellant cos there's some mosquitos roaming around. Staff are awesome! So friendly and was able to explain every inquiries I have. I also get to watch how they made my vegan matcha! Sooooo satisfying! As a matcha enthusiast, their Vegan Matcha is soo good! Love the oatmilk they used and the match is somewhat umami and smooth! I love it! First time to try gokou matcha. My husband had their Concrete Latte. It's a cold latte with ice cream on top. It's not too sweet which my husband likes. My brother-in-law had their raspberry juice soda. Feels like it's made from fresh raspberries. They also have hot food and pastries. their Caramel Macchiatto, nothing special. I just wish the prices are a bit lower cos the price point feels like you're in Manila.
such a pretty and relaxing place to have an afternoon coffee or tea! the place also has a free museum inside and it's surrounded by beautiful nature🌱

Speeding up to this place on the first day of a long (holiday) weekend is never a bad idea. Terrible signal in spite of the open-air building will not leave you disenchanted. Huge dining with unique spaces, a gallery to browse through art and furniture pieces makes it a trip-worthy encounter for first timers. The ramshackle facade further adds to its allure. Belgian Ichigo and Shrimp Fra Diavolo are just two of the yellow stars to check out. Before any of that— heads up on the lengthy road under construction along the way….'Coz parking is at the opposite side, be mindful, keep your eyes peeled for passing vehicles while crossing the street… Place has different levels so I stayed close to the cashier so food would arrive faster… Wonderful place to bring guests here early.
Their cafe is a bit off the beaten track, but the travel time is worth it. Their iced matcha latte is legit delicious. For dessert, try their matcha soft serve and croffle.

My friends and I had our Christmas Party here and we had the best time! 🎄❤️ The overall vibe of the place really matched the Christmas spirit we wanted plus their coffee is really goOooOod 😭 I had, of course, my staple Spanish Latté (along with a slice of Matilda cake which for me is a little dry, but okay nonetheless) and my friends ordered a Mocha Latté and a Revel Bar. I highly recommend to visit here and have your simple secret santa with friends if you like the cozy and chill vibe ✨

Wood and Coffee is a charming café known for its cozy ambiance and excellent brews. The rustic decor and friendly staff create a welcoming atmosphere, perfect for relaxing or catching up with friends. Their artisanal coffee and delectable pastries make it a standout spot for coffee lovers.

A very unique place with great drinks and food. I highly recommend the Pastrami Sandwich and the Concrete Latte. Edit: My new favorite drink is their Ube Vanilla Latte, it tastes like a Donut in a good way!

The ambience of the café is great, cozy, peaceful, and surrounded by nature-inspired decor. The WiFi is fast, making it a good spot to chill or get some work done. Pero, ang ironic lang that a place designed with nature vibes isn't environmentally friendly. Everything is SERVED in PLASTICS, with no reusable options available. Nag-ask ako if pwede ba ang coffee be served in a mug, but they said that's not an option. I tried to avoid using a straw, but the design of their plastic cups made it difficult. I really hope they consider more sustainable practices in the future to match the vibe they're going for.
Something to try in Davao, love there matcha with banana pudding 😊,plus they have an art gallery that u can visit
Nice ambiance, good food.
Far from the city— you definitely need a car if you go here. Matcha x art x date. 🍵💚
Lamian ila foods. Super delicious. A little bit overpriced but i think they're including something for the gallery as well so yeah understandable. The place is nice. Cozy.
I highly recommend this shop because the place is clean, looks very good, calm and big, I cannot believe how clean the place looks considering how big it is. The visit here is worth ir.
been here twice and i love this place! the aura is like pinto art ❤️
I had one of the best Spanish Latte in Davao. It's off the beaten track but well worth it to check it out. Their ambiance and decor is on point.
Beautiful ambience, live music and good food. Need I say more ? It's far from the city so it's hard to find a taxi while going back.
Great food, best place to muni-muni 😄

The food here is great, a little bit pricey for some but for me the price is very reasonable because it is very tasty and it has a decent amount per serving. The ambiance is very nice and the place has a very cool vibe to it.
Good place. Food and coffee can be improved. Gallery experience is a plus
Impression of this establishment is truly appreciate 🙏. As a Portuguese citizen visiting davao city is a gem. Amazing food. Art work is a gold mine here. Art gallery. Worth to visit.

I love this place. Let me start with that. Coffee is strong, cookies are the best, But having gone here for years now, I can attest to a decline in service speed, even when there are only 3 other people in the location. Usually, I don't care, and because the view is so nice here, I'm happy to look at trees for a bit longer. But there was a recent addition of a 5% service charge that wasn't there before. My feedback is simple; don't charge for your service if you're going to let your service decline. However I must say, all the staff here are incredible, accommodating and welcoming. I have no issue with their characters whatsoever. Great people. So anyway, If something is ready, why not bring it up? I have frequently gone all the way down stairs to see part of my order sitting on the counter getting cold because they're waiting for the rest of the order to bring it up in one go. Why? I don't know. But it's annoying, especially now that I'm constantly reminded I'm paying for this service. I'd rather be able to opt out and serve myself.
I love this place. One of Davao's hidden gems. Coffee is phenomenal and staff is great. Always one of my stops when in Davao.
Food, everything I've tried are all good. Their drinks are great too! Wifi was fast and free. Staff were accommodating.

Best place in Davao to unwind, this is where art meets nature. Aside from the impressive selection of drinks, food and deserts there is a an art gallery which showcases ,Gil Bumanlag's art. The service crew are always friendly whenever I visit and the quality of the food remains up to standard even when the cafe gets crowded. I would definitely consider Wood and Coffee a place to visit when you need to get away from the hustle and bustle of the city.
the place was quiet and secluded plus the good was great!
Poor customer service; iced coffee takes more than 30mins to make (takeout), no apology from staff for the delay. Coffee tastes okay. Street parking only. 2 stars for the view and ambiance though
A must-visit coffeeshop in Davao !!!

I will go for 4 star for now. Its a bit overrated for me since i expected too much on the taste of the coffee. Maybe if you think about the price and quality ration, But overall it was great. Still a must try place.
cozy and nice place to visit.

Visit to take photos but the food is ok, nothing to write home about. The service is not very good. Staff is distracted, not very courteous. Orders take a loooong time.

,, great and wonderful experience..🥰💥💖

The Wi-Fi is a problem, but the iced Americano seems to be the best in Davao.
The place is good but it takes toooo long to serve the food. Then when they served you the food was cold, I thought the meal was too hot because we had been waiting for more than an hour.

Their place is beautiful. I appreciate the Gallery area. 10/10 (11/10 if there was aircon or fan) hehe. Their CR really needs improvement but all in all the place is really nice for me. Relaxing close to nature with many trees. 🙌🏻 All in all the food was 7/10 for me. We ordered quite a lot because it's my birthday. Hmmmm it's okay too ☺️ Pasta - 6/10 I don't know but maybe it was just that time that the pasta was soggy. Honestly, my son and I didn't finish it. Baby back ribs- 9/10 my friend said Basque Cheesecake - 7.5/10 Cookies - 10/10 my kids said Coffee - 8/10 Sandwiches - 9/10 Thank you 😘😘😘😘
Food is ok, delicious and usual found in restos & coffee shops. The place though is very nice. If you just want to rest your mind, this is one good venue for staring out at nature.
